description: Optional reviewer step for /delegate: an independent read-only reviewer worker checks a story commit before the advisor accepts it.

userStories.title: Optional reviewer step before acceptance
userStories.description: As an advisor, I want an optional independent reviewer for a story so that a second context checks each change before I accept it.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/skills/prd/references/tracker.md` documents an optional story field `review` boolean with the default `false`. The text states that the field does not change `schemaVersion`.

`.agro/skills/delegate/SKILL.md` § Acceptance states that, if a story has `review: true`, the advisor dispatches one read-only reviewer worker after the implementer commit and before the advisor brings the commit onto the task branch.

The reviewer brief in `.agro/skills/delegate/SKILL.md` states that the reviewer starts in a fresh context, reads the story criteria and the worker commit, edits no file, and labels each finding `blocking` or `non-blocking`.
§ Acceptance states that a `blocking` finding returns the story to the same implementer worker as a bounded repair, and that the advisor allows at most 2 review rounds for each story.
§ Acceptance states that the reviewer never accepts, and that the advisor still runs each verification step.

§ Model policy states that the reviewer uses a model other than the implementer model when one is available. If no other model is available, the reviewer uses the implementer model in a fresh context, and the advisor records that fact in `notes`.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh .agro/skills/delegate/SKILL.md` reports no finding on a line that this story adds.
userStories.notes: Worker model: opus (provider default). No review round: review not set. C1-C6 reasoned: advisor inspected the diff of delegate/SKILL.md (Reviewer brief, Acceptance step 2, repair paragraph with 2-round cap, Model policy bullet) and tracker.md (review field, default false, no schemaVersion change). C7 executed: ste-check.sh on delegate/SKILL.md and tracker.md exit 0. C8 executed: pnpm test exit 0 (108 files, 2574 passed, 2 skipped). C9 executed: pnpm typecheck exit 0. Worker added one sentence beyond the criteria for the case after 2 rounds; advisor kept it.

userStories.title: Council owns its budget stop
userStories.description: As an advisor, I want `/council` to own its budget stop so that `/council` names no missing `/delegate` rule.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/skills/council/SKILL.md` § 3 states that, at budget exhaustion, the advisor dispatches no further worker and reports `PARTIAL` with the accepted observations and the missing coverage.
`.agro/skills/council/references/scenarios.md` § Partial evidence and critic failure names the same council budget stop.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh .agro/skills/council/SKILL.md .agro/skills/council/references/scenarios.md` reports no finding on a line that this story adds.
userStories.notes: Worker model: opus (provider default). C1-C2 reasoned: advisor read council/SKILL.md section 3 and scenarios.md; both name the council budget stop with PARTIAL; SKILL.md adds BLOCKED when no observation exists, consistent with section 5. C3 executed: git grep budget-stop .agro/skills exit 1, no lines. C4 executed: ste-check.sh on both files exit 0. C5 executed: pnpm test exit 0. C6 executed: pnpm typecheck exit 0.
